verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections has a dedicated webhooks documentation page. It lists outbound event types a consumer can receive: account linked (one event per account), and balance, ownership and transaction refresh completed, plus guidance on reconnecting inactive accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation in the pack of webhook endpoint registration and signature verification, the full event catalog and payload schemas, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Sent when a customer links a new account. If they link multiple accounts, it emits multiple events (one per account).
Sent after a balance refresh is complete.
Sent after an ownership refresh is complete.
Sent after a transaction refresh is complete.
